pages.title: Theory of Everything
pages.text: $(thing)Theory of Everything$()$(br2)Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

$(thing)Insight$(): 500$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Conceptual Singularities, Grand Unification, General Relativity, M-Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 M-Theory Core.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Write one action for everything known: spacetime curvature with a vacuum energy, the gauge fields with field strength F_μν, matter fermions ψ moving through the gauge-covariant derivative D_μ, and the scalar field φ whose potential has its minimum at |φ| = v. Integrate the sum of all their Lagrangian densities over spacetime with the invariant volume factor built from the metric determinant g.
